display.title: Episode 287: The Dike (Tisha B'Av)
display.summary_short: A Tisha B'Av show: the three things the world stands on, a girl lost in a flood who is led home by Shabbos candles, and the ancient tune of Eichah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Tisha B'Av 5747. Uncle Yossi teaches that the world stands on three things, Torah, Avodah and Gemilus Chasadim, a daily 'diet' for a healthy neshamah, with tzedakah as the crown of kindness. A young yeshiva boy recites the Shema in Studio 604. Story time tells 'The Dike': in a Dutch town by the sea, a dike breaks and little Gittel, slowed by an old injury, is left behind. A harsh old woman carries her to her cottage, tells her she has no family left, and keeps her working for three years, until Gittel forgets how to live as a Jewish girl. Walking home from a fair one Friday night, she sees Shabbos candles in a window, remembers her mother's Shabbos table, knocks, and finds her own family. Uncle Yossi then explains why, even in the Three Weeks, we may listen to the sad, hopeful melody of Eichah, which is chanted on air, and reviews the customs of Tisha B'Av. The show ends with candle time and the summer mitzvah charts.
display.lesson: The light of Shabbos and the mitzvos we grew up with can always bring a Jew back home.
